name: DC-GNK
description: DC-GNK was a originally a GNK-series power droid, later heavily modified to serve as a translator by Jawa Empideera Kkek. DC-GNK was outfitted with a number of salvaged protocol droid parts, allowing him to help Kkek in trade negotiations. Although DC-GNK was grateful for his transformation into a more intelligent droid, he longed to have his own life, away from the Jawas.
